workarounds.symptom: IterableDataset.to_dict() and to_polars() return an empty generator instead of the data

Picks up #8382 after [the original author handed it over](https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/issues/8381#issuecomment-[REDACTED]). The original fix is by @ebarkhordar. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8632)

workarounds.symptom: `IterableDataset.shuffle()` in 5.0 reports `num_shards = min(files per source)`, leaving DataLoader workers and distributed nodes without data
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve source shards when shuffling iterable datasets. Target files: src/datasets/iterable_dataset.py, tests/test_distributed.py, tests/test_iterable_dataset.py. `IterableDataset.shuffle()` currently interleaves the source shards before node and DataLoader worker sharding. With 19 source shards and the default settings, the resulting dataset reports one shard, leaving three of four DataLoader workers idle. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8670)

workarounds.symptom: IterableDataset.filter fails with arrow, pandas and polars formats
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix IterableDataset.filter with arrow, pandas and polars formats. Target files: src/datasets/iterable_dataset.py, tests/test_iterable_dataset.py. `IterableDataset.filter` raised for every table format (`arrow`, `pandas`, `polars`), although the integration guides say it works the same way as `IterableDataset.map`. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8725)
